extraction_notes: Transfer, output, gate-charge, RDS(on), capacitance, and source-drain diode curves were digitized from the typical figures on p. 5-6; axes, curve labels, and stated test conditions are retained.
The transfer characteristic is shown at VDS = 9 V. The output characteristic includes representative VGS = 5 V, 7 V, and 10 V traces. The figures do not state temperature or pulse conditions.
The capacitance table specifies VDS = 50 V, f = 1 MHz, and VGS = 0 V. Figure 8 provides the voltage-dependent Ciss, Coss, and Crss traces; its temperature is not stated.
Figure 12 provides source-drain diode curves at TJ = -55 degC, 25 degC, and 175 degC. The 25 degC curve is retained for the typical body-diode value.
The RDS(on) table publishes a typical value of 0.007 ohm and a maximum value of 0.008 ohm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 8 A; the supplied schema stores the typical resistance in rdson_points.

Published values not represented by the supplied schema include maximum ratings, leakage, gate charge table limits, switching times, reverse-recovery charge and time, avalanche energy, thermal resistance, and temperature-normalized curves; relevant curve data and primary supported table values are retained where schema fields exist.
extraction.omission_reason: The published transfer, output, capacitance, gate-charge, RDS(on), and source-drain diode curves are usable and are represented in curves. The supplied schema has no fields for leakage, switching times, reverse-recovery charge or time, avalanche energy, thermal resistance, maximum table limits beyond the required scalar fields, or temperature-normalized curves, so those values are omitted from structured specs.
